name: antigravity-subagent
description: Plan with Codex, execute bounded PLAN tasks with Antigravity, and avoid repeated long handoff output through server-side blueprint capture and prompt construction.

interface.shortDescription: Codex-planned, AGY-executed workflows with deep Codex review.
interface.longDescription: Adds canonical execution blueprints, server-side PLAN capture/prompt construction, persistent resumable Antigravity workers, deterministic scope/validation evidence, correction routing, recovery, and Codex semantic review while avoiding repeated large PLAN output from Codex.
defaultPrompt: Create an implementation-ready execution blueprint for this repository.
Execute the approved READY blueprint with Antigravity workers and Codex review.
Use Antigravity as a bounded worker for this standalone task.
Ask Antigravity for a second opinion and verify it independently.
